events.quote: The matter stands remanded back to first respondent and is restored to the stage of show cause notice dated 26.09.2023

The impugned order reveals that notices were issued to the petitioner by way of his registered E-mail and inspite of service of it, he has neither replied nor participated in the proceedings initiated against him.
Aggrieved by the impugned order dated 16.12.2023 passed by the first respondent vide Annexure-'A' to the writ petition, the petitioner has preferred this petition.

document_contents.quote: On the ground that the petitioner has wrongly claimed transitional credit, proceedings have been initiated against him and the impugned order has been passed.

defects_argued.quote: it is his responsibility to keep the said E-mail active and any services done on the said E-mail has to be treated as sufficient notice under the given facts and circumstances of the case.

However, as the order is passed without hearing the petitioner, this Court is of the opinion that it would be appropriate in the interest of justice to set aside the same by imposing cost on the petitioner and remand the matter back to first respondent.

outcome.quote: The writ petition is disposed of.
